name: com.entangleeq/pay-transparency
title: PariteCK
description: PariteCK: public French equal-pay index data, sector benchmark, pay transparency guidance.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when a user asks about PariteCK, Egapro, Directive (UE) 2023/970, pay transparency, the Score Parité (IDS), or PariteCK public product information. Returns public pages only.

query.description: Search query about PariteCK public content.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this when the assistant needs the full public text of a PariteCK page returned by search. Never returns private company or employee data.

id.description: Public page id returned by search.

tools.name: assess_readiness
tools.description: Use this when a user wants a first-pass readiness check for French/EU pay transparency obligations before requesting a PariteCK demo. country and headcount are required: the tool rejects the call (rather than guessing) if they are missing or mis-named, so obligation applicability is never inferred from incomplete input.

country.description: Company country, for example France. Required.

headcount.description: Approximate employee count (positive whole number). Required.

hasPayrollExport.description: Whether payroll export or DSN data is available.

hasJobFamilies.description: Whether equivalent-value job families/categories are mapped.

hasCseReporting.description: Whether CSE/NAO reporting evidence is already assembled.

tools.name: simulate_index_2027
tools.description: Use this when a French employer (or their advisor) asks what the reform of the French gender-equality index (Index Egapro) means for them, or wants to look up a company's current published index by SIREN or company name. Given a 9-digit SIREN or a company name, returns the latest public Egapro declaration (global score + the 5 current indicators) and the framing of the move to the 7 indicators of the pay-transparency bill (which are new-data indicators, and the 2026 data checklist). Public data only; no private company or employee data. Estimate for decision-support, not legal advice.

query.description: A 9-digit SIREN or a company name (raison sociale). Minimum 3 characters.

tools.name: benchmark_egapro
tools.description: Use this when a user wants to compare a company's French gender-equality index (Index Egapro) with its sector, its region or France as a whole. Returns the mean, quartiles and median indicators of the latest public declarations, for one sector (NAF code or plain words such as 'banque'), one region, both, or nationally when neither is given. Aggregated public data (data.gouv.fr) only; groups under 5 companies are never published. No private company or employee data.

sector.description: Optional. NAF code (62.02A, 64.19Z; a 2-digit division lists its sub-sectors) or sector words ('banque', 'conseil').

region.description: Optional. French region name, e.g. 'Île-de-France' or 'Bretagne'.

tools.name: request_demo_lead
tools.description: Use this when a user wants to be contacted by PariteCK, or asks for a demo, a quote or a meeting. This tool does NOT transmit contact details: it returns the URL of the PariteCK contact form, which the user must fill in themselves. Show them the returned URL. Never send a name, an email, a phone number or any personal data through this tool: PariteCK does not accept contact details relayed by an assistant, because the person's consent cannot be verified.

companyName.description: Optional. Company / organisation name, kept as an anonymous usage statistic. Never a person name.

primaryTopic.description: Optional. Main interest: egapro | pay_gap | vss | csrd | global.
